snippet.title: First Cutscene from Any World
snippet.description:
WIP: First Cutscene from Any World 

We are a small indie studio called IdeaGame, and we are developing a 3D platformer called Any World!

You can learn more in our Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1881280/Any_World/

A retro 3D-Platformer about an alien named Ottis. Repair your portal device to get back home! Leap across the seven worlds of Emria: from pixelated depths to clay-themed skies. Collect parts, battle aliens, and keep running!
